_source: docs/plans/2026-09-30-owner-decisions.md, sections 'Owner decisions 2026-10-01: cell list and per-cell history spans' and 'Owner decisions 2026-10-01 (symbol universe)'
_symbols_why: Per-cell symbol lists (owner 2026-10-01, symbol universe): 5m-metals and 15m-metals = XAUUSD XAGUSD XPTUSD XPDUSD (4; XAUUSD from 2004-06-11 sets the folds, XPTUSD and XPDUSD from 2015-01-07 are the late symbols); 5m-indices and 15m-indices = US500 US30 USTEC DE40 FRA40 UK100 EU50 JP225 HK50 AUS200 US2000 SPN35 N25 (13); both 1m cells keep their original symbols. Every symbol must be in scripts/fund-search.py FUND_SYMBOLS with the cell's asset class (checked on load). A symbol with no development data before the cutoff is not in m; a symbol whose data starts after the cell's start is kept in m and disclosed (symbol_first_bar): it adds trades only to the folds where it has bars and still counts in the ceil(2m/3) stability denominator. Folds follow the cell's EARLIEST symbol.
_why: The cell list and each cell's history START are part of the pre-registration: declared here, read by `scripts/fund-search.py plan`, hashed into the plan core (plan_hash) and pinned in the ledger declaration (evaluation_config.cells_sha256) exactly like the V grids. `run`/`scan` refuse a changed file. dev_start null = the cell starts at the first bar its data has (from data, as before); a string = a declared later start of the cell's development data (decision-timeframe series only; higher-timeframe series used by gates/W7 keep their full point-in-time history). The development CUTOFF (2024-03-01, the end of every span) is not set here: it is scripts/fund_stats.py DEV_CUTOFF and is unchanged. Any future non-null dev_start MUST be accompanied by a re-run of scripts/research/span_equivalence.py for that cell (method x a symbol of the cell) showing the cut run equals the full-series run from dev_start; trade-count and power evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-01-trade-rates.md, docs/audits/2026-10-01-power-model.md.
_warmup_days_why: Calendar days of decision bars scanned BEFORE a declared dev_start so the scan's per-window dedupe state and simulate()'s one-position-at-a-time state settle; trades whose entry is before dev_start are discarded (they exist in no fold). On top of the method's own window (ICT scan_spec bars / Wyckoff window). Unused while every dev_start is null.
